input: After a successful physical read, return alternating 32-sample blocks of 40000 and 41000 mC; reset the trace at the start of every batch.
trial: N8R8, 240 MHz, one core, 1 ms scheduling tick. Each TLS-tagged gap is the elapsed time from switching away from the trend thread to scheduling it again. The main agent thread ran inside mbedtls_ssl_handshake for GET rendered during at least part of each tagged gap. Other runnable tasks and interrupts can also run during the same gap. No time is charged to a gap until it ends. The app reads the physical sensor before substituting 40/41 C and preserves the INFO log and agent notification. No state UART logging.

sched_extra_fields.gaps: slot -> duration in Xtensa elapsed cycles, including other threads or interrupts before app resumption
